title: Unknown usage
description: The data of a `usage.unknown` event: one accounting unit (an agent run, a model call, a website turn) whose usage the resource ledger could not count, recorded by the Worker source that meters it (design/resources.md, usage the ledger cannot count). A cap counts the unit as 0 until the ledger counts a usage record of its run in its pool: then it is reconciled. Never an estimate of the usage.

runId.description: The unit, as a usage record of it names its `runId` (an agent Worker's run). The unit is reconciled once the ledger counts a record of this run in `pool`.

kind.description: not-reported: the unit ended and its runtime reported neither tokens nor turns; interrupted: the host stopped while it ran, so no result came; refused: the ledger refused its usage record (`failure`); failed: recording it failed otherwise (the ledger threw).

pool.description: The pool the unit drew on, as the Worker's configuration names it.

reason.description: Why its usage is unknown: what the runtime reported, or the ledger's own message.

failure.description: Why the ledger refused the record (`ResourcesError`), for `refused`.

record.description: For `refused`: the usage record the ledger refused, kept as an `evidence` artifact (`usage-record@1.0`), so its numbers are not lost; absent when it is not a valid record.
